toolchain: DPC++ 2025.3.2 / oneMKL 2025.3 / Level Zero / fp:precise / correctly-rounded divide-sqrt
scope: Hot real single-expert weights, deterministic Gaussian activations, current source and production IQ2_XS kernel environment. No whole-model throughput measurement.

methods.projection: Global FP16 dequantization + oneMKL FP32-accumulate GEMM vs fused dequantization into SLM + FP16-input FP32-accumulate joint_matrix. GU: Mx2560 times 2560x1280. Down: Mx640 times 640x2560.
methods.decode_expert: Baseline: FP32 -> Q8 -> native_expert_grouped GU/SwiGLU/Q8/down. Candidate: FP32 -> FP16 -> XMX GU -> SwiGLU/Q8 -> iq_mmvq down. Includes conversions, host submission and queue completion.
methods.screen: Four real experts (IQ2_S, IQ2_XXS, IQ1_M control, Q2_0), M=1/4/6/16/40/160/256, both roles, variants 0-3. Stock, 512-element K slabs, and two-subgroup workgroups. Three batches of eight calls per phase.
methods.confirm: Three fresh processes per target format. M=1/4/6/40/160, projection variants 1/3, full expert M=1/4/6. A/B/A, three warmups then nine batches of 128 calls per phase, wait at batch end. Per-process phase median, baseline sqrt(A1*A2). Summary uses medians across processes and fastest candidate variant.
methods.correctness: Projection: packed-XMX bitwise equality, relative L1 <=1e-5 and max absolute error <=1e-4*(1+max absolute reference) vs oneMKL; finite outputs. Full expert: relative L1 <=3% screening gate; this is not model-output or quality validation.

sources.technique: FP16-accumulate MMA partial products are converted and added to separate FP32 registers. Requires an FP16-accumulate MMA instruction.
sources.reported_accuracy: Two-stage absolute error roughly 100x FP16/FP32; pure FP16 accumulation roughly 1000x; normally distributed inputs.

sources.technique: Triton tl.dot out_dtype chooses float16 accumulator. README comparison also changes BF16 inputs to FP16 and changes the GEMM implementation; it is not a clean accumulator-only comparison.
Architecture-specific attention kernels combine INT8 QK and FP16/FP8 PV with buffered accumulation. These are attention benchmarks, not IQ2/Q2 MoE expert GEMM benchmarks.
Selects cuBLAS CUBLAS_COMPUTE_16F by architecture and shape; default choices differ on sm_100 and sm_120.

github_research.a770_conclusion: DG2 FP16 XMX uses FP32 accumulators. NVIDIA FP16 MMA instructions and cuBLAS switches cannot be transferred. Reuse, layout, batching and integer matrix instructions can be investigated separately; no measured Intel speedup follows from the NVIDIA results.

limitations: One real expert per target format in confirmation (expert 7, IQ2_XS layers 0/1 and Q2_0 layer 0); synthetic activations.
29/207 comparisons exceed 3% baseline drift; all retained. The six report rows stay below 3%. No marginal improvement is accepted from drifting samples.
INT8 DPAS and whole-model throughput were not tested. No candidate was integrated.
